title: Deep cleaning
summary: A thorough top-to-bottom clean for a seasonal reset, before an event or ahead of a regular schedule.

meta.title: Deep cleaning in Luxembourg
meta.description: Thorough, top-to-bottom deep cleaning for homes in Luxembourg: inside cupboards, appliances, limescale and the details a regular clean does not reach.

hero.intro: A meticulous, room-by-room reset for the corners, fittings and surfaces that everyday cleaning leaves alone. Ideal each season, before an event or as the starting point for a regular routine.

image.alt: A gleaming kitchen with spotless worktops and polished stainless steel

included.intro: Everything in a regular visit, plus the details below. We confirm the exact scope in writing before the day.

groups.title: Kitchen in depth

groups.title: Bathrooms in depth

groups.title: Throughout the home

High surfaces, light fittings and tops of wardrobes dusted

faq.question: How long does a deep clean take?
faq.answer: It depends on the size and condition of the home. A two-bedroom apartment usually takes a team most of a day. We give you a time estimate with the quote.

faq.question: Do I need to empty cupboards beforehand?
faq.answer: It helps if valuables and fragile items are put away. We can empty and refill kitchen cupboards ourselves, carefully and in the same order.

faq.question: Is oven and fridge cleaning included?
faq.answer: Yes, the inside of the oven, microwave and fridge is part of a deep clean. Let us know about any appliance with special care instructions.

faq.question: Can you clean carpets and windows at the same time?
faq.answer: Yes. Exterior windows and carpet or upholstery care can be added to the same visit and appear as separate lines on your quote.
